notes.title: Blockchain Tycoon Full Release
notes.notes:
Blockchain Tycoon is leaving Early Access today. With the release of the Phase 2 version, development of the game is finished. The game was completely redesigned according to initial feedback. Since the first release in August 2018, the game has improved greatly. Making a game about mining cryptocurrencies had its challenges compared to conventional management simulation games. We’ve tried to provide a unique experience to both experts and enthusiasts. From now on, updates will focus on bug fixes and improvements. We greatly appreciate your support throughout this project. We hope to see you soon in future games. 

- Wamill Team

notes.title: Alpha 3.3 - Research Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

In this update, we have redesigned the research tree. While still having price decrease research for GPU and ASIC, hash-rate research is completely removed from the tree. If you continue from a previous save file, you don’t lose your research points but the previously completed research is erased from the save files. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32337583/e04b68f2c5022c6873b4c0e0a9766bb0492cd5ae.png

Each research cost 20 points and they start from 5% and goes up to 50%. The power-up values does not add up to the latest value you had. Instead, you receive a power up on top of the base value. For example, If you are researching the production output power up 5 times (25%), you receive total of 25% more output per day and not 75% (5+10+15+20+25). 

Here are the new research options: 

 GPU price decrease 
 ASIC price decrease
 Repair price decrease
 Increased power capacity
 Increased cooling capacity
 Increased energy output for production
 Increased coin earnings


Fixes and Changes

 Redesigned research tree
 Slightly more research point earnings per expert
 Updates to new game selection interface which shows the startup cash now. 


Research tree update was suggested by our community member @tomkloosterman. The research was planned to be completely removed. Thanks for the help and suggestion. 

Feel free to share your feedback and suggestions through discussion forums.

notes.title: Alpha 2.1.3 Released - Balance Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Alpha 2.1.3 is available today. The update is focused on game balance. So, many of the improvements are under-the-hood. The first thing you’ll notice will be the price increase of coins you created in ICO. Sadly, there are no more million dollar per coin prices even if you have very high hype value. 

ICO coins are also included in mining statistics menu now. You can see the same statistics and market cap for all ICO coins. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32337583/c4fb346ba39795a1780aca740e9d2f2fce2a84ef.png

ICO price was not visible in the main game screen and you had to open the exchange menu to see its price. They are now included as the same place as BTX and ETX. You can also click to select them to see the chart of any coin. ICO research steps of a coin must be completed to see their price. Otherwise, it is not possible to exchange the coin and coin does not have a price yet. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32337583/8884511b69ce3c92ae461d30c60434e6d8c9b977.png

Fixes

 No more button sounds (as requested by community). Enabling / disabling button sounds in the settings menu might be included in a future update. 
 Fixed the alpha version number in main menu (reported by community). 
 Initial price of ICO coins are now higher. 
 ICO coins are now increasing so much in a small time period. Coin price does not increase from 100 to 5000 that quickly. But, it is still wise to have high hype value :wink: 
 Parameters are decreased for BTX price increase events. 
 Fixed a bug causing shelf information tooltip to constantly flash. 
 Fixed a bug causing the BTX and ETX chart in game screen to appear out of bounds of the given area (reported by community).

notes.title: ICO Update - Alpha 2.1 Released
notes.notes:
Finally! Alpha 2.1 is available today! 

You can now create coins and mine them. 

What is New?

ICO

How does it work?

 Hire Engineers & Growth Hackers to earn points.
 Create your own coin using a research tree. Complete research steps.
 Select mining method (GPU-only, ASIC-only, or both)
 Launch your ICO in which you sell coins to investors from an initial price. You also get some coins in ICO.
 Launch coin to the public. After doing so, you can now mine this coin and buy & sell it from the exchange menu like regular coins.
 After the coin is launched, your task does not finish. You have to do Maintenance and Marketing. There will be bugs in your code that you need to fix. Bugs will decrease the popularity of your coin. You also have to do marketing to keep your coin popular.
 Try to keep the ‘Hype’ of your coin high for maximum profit.


There is no limit on the number of coins you can create. Other miners in your simulated world can also mine the coins created in ICOs. But, this depends on the popularity (Hype) of your coin. Price of the coins created in ICOs also depends on the Hype.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32337583/908e2ea3c03b57f1b4d8c5792aa9f56e71e3febf.png

Fixes

 Research experts does not earn research points if there are unpaid salaries. 
 Exchange menu is redesigned to show the price of all coins and amount of coins you have in the same screen. 
 Removed the initial 1million capital to buy the first warehouse. Now, you get the first warehouse for free. 
 Removed the individual coin mining selection on hardware units. You can now select to change what GPU’s and ASIC’s are mining separately in the shelf menu. 
 Changes to save file structure. This made the old save files unusable in the new version. Also, there won’t be ‘continue’ button in the main menu if the old save file is not compatible with the new version. 
 Hash-rate labels in HUD are now in separate labels under the HUD to support the new coins. 


Trailer

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3MoIWgu6FoE

notes.title: Alpha 2 Sneak Peek (ICO) & Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
Alpha 2 is in development for two months. It will be available before the New Year’s if there are no major bugs preventing the gameplay. 

Highlight of the update will be the new coin creation mechanic that will allow you to create your own coin and mine it. As you might have guessed, it is called ICO!. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32337583/4a4a2cf02e644e16d01602741a737e60fba6a194.png

You will have a separate tech tree to create your own coin. You can also choose the coin to be mineable with GPU-only, ASIC-only, or both. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32337583/77f04a3fe13124dcdda15d00b593e15e84b4631c.png

The coins created with an ICO is selectable using a dropdown menu to be mined with the GPU and ASIC. Similar to BTX and ETX in the game, other miners in your simulated world can also mine the coin. This will effect the difficulty and reward calculations like in real life. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32337583/675cd401a41d2be8ec5a7448d93043ac5fed6e28.png

Price of a coin is determined by several parameters similar to default coins in the game. But for the ICO coins, you will have options to increase popularity of a coin, so that the price of the coin might increase over time. There will be more details in the update notes. There should be a mechanism that prevents you from owning all coins of the one you have created. If you constantly buy your own coin from other miners and try to increase the price to make more profit, you might get penalized for the behavior (like a price decrease because the coin is not popular anymore). 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32337583/9624eab2846b586c56585dfbe08094eecff67719.png

There will be no limit for the number of coins you will create in the first version of the Alpha 2. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32337583/c04915ed5f1390eb1670391060aed766772b2185.png

Roadmap

The first version of the roadmap was showing depreciation system and hardware release system after the ICO update. Also, there will be improvements on the depreciation system later. The systems that have an initial version have half-stars. Roadmap will look like this after Alpha 2 update and the rest of the steps are the same for now. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32337583/45b89497b1dc9c4f3df98dd005eac793a0046739.png

Thanks to everyone who gave suggestions by forum and emails. Also, special thanks to everyone who patiently waited for this update. 

Feedback and suggestions are always welcome.
